lines.text: Brihat Jataka
If the planets happen to be of equal strength in mathematical
calculation their relative strength is decided on the basis of
their natural strength. In this scheme Saturn is the weakest of
all planets. Mars is stronger than Saturn, Mercury is stronger
than Mars, Jupiter is stronger than Mercury, Venus is stron-
ger than Jupiter, Moon is stronger than Venus and Sun is
stronger than Moon.
इति श्रीवराहमिहिरकृते बृहज्जातके ग्रहयोनिप्रभेदाध्याय: द्वितीय: ।।2।।
Thus ends the second chapter on Planets in Brihat Jatak
composed by Varahamihira.
